sql:
SELECT
  title,
  AI.GENERATE_INT(
    ("Rate the sentiment of this article title from 1 (very negative) to 5 (very positive): ", title)
  ).result AS sentiment_score
FROM `bigquery-public-data.bbc_news.fulltext`
LIMIT 3
